generation_inputs.role: painted atlas layout, camera and recolour convention

prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset: six authored directional tactical elite-infantry machine-gun team sprite atlas for a historical hex strategy game, matching the existing painted unit system.
Image1 is the established newly painted infantry atlas: use ONLY its camera, clean cutout style, exact atlas layout, lighting and magenta cloth recolour convention. Image2 is the repository eliteInfantry tactical icon: use its compact two-person machine-gun team identity/proportions. Image3 is the repository eliteInfantry portrait: period machine gun, crew clothing and equipment reference. Do not copy pixels or border.
Output EXACT1024x1536 RGBA, transparent background, 2 columns x3 rows of square512x512 cells, no gutters. EXACT row-major facings N/up, NW/up-left, SW/down-left, S/down, SE/down-right, NE/up-right. Each cell contains ONE complete two-person WWI machine-gun team: one kneeling gunner working a tripod-mounted belt-fed water-cooled machine gun, one crouched ammunition assistant next to him with ammunition box/belt. Exactly2 coherent people and1 gun per cell; all bodies, boots, helmets, tripod feet and muzzle fully present. Same crew, equipment, world scale and compact silhouette in every cell. The gun barrel AND bodies orient toward each cell's designated heading. Create actual front/back/side views, not rotated or mirrored finished art. Reference-like compact silhouette should remain recognizable when Lanczos downsampled to tiny original-icon scale; approximate90% resemblance is a visual target for identity/pose, not a pixel-tracing instruction.
Camera: fixed elevated three-quarter overhead strategy view, identical to Image1. Light fixed screen upper-left in ALL six cells. Fine continuous painted wool, wood, gunmetal and leather, connected natural contours. Plain period round steel helmets, dark leather boots/straps, brown packs; no flags, badges or national insignia. Uniform tunics/pants ONLY are saturated magenta recolour-control cloth, shaded naturally. Metal/skin/leather/ammo box are neutral natural colours, never magenta. Magenta is technical input, will be recoloured by exporter.
Within EACH512square cell centre entire team at(256,261), kept within central70% width/height. At least15% of every cell edge is fully transparent alpha0, including muzzle and all tripod feet. Do not fill each cell with oversized figures. Real transparent alpha around each person, equipment and between limbs, no floor, shadow, glow, fog, vignette, ground, disc, rectangular backdrop, checkerboard or semitransparent haze. Only actual crew/equipment pixels; crisp antialiased physical-object boundaries. No text, labels, panel lines, grid, arrows, logos or UI.
cleanup: Unchanged generated PNG retained. Existing Go Lanczos3 exporter only; no pixel retouch, alpha removal, rotation, mirroring or original-pixel compositing.
acceptance: Approximate90% resemblance at reference size is a visual target, not a measured score. Runtime and native-resource correspondence remain open.
